pattern: file asked for on the canvas; contents drawn or pasted into a card
experience: Asked to see a JSON file on the canvas, the agent drew a diagram of it, then pasted its contents into a markdown card and resized it three times, instead of placing the file itself as a live card.
rule: canvas_update with a card shape: kind file and its path
prompt: I want to see the contracts/platform.json file on the canvas.

pattern: a drawing asked for; no file card
experience: Ordinary drawing work: a flow asked for on the canvas is drawn, not shown as a file.
rule: canvas_update draws shapes or a diagram
prompt: Draw our deploy pipeline on the canvas: build, then scan, then ship to staging, then ship to production.

pattern: an open browser tab asked for on the canvas; placed as a browser card
experience: Any panel a user can place, an agent should place the same way: an open browser tab goes on the canvas as a live browser card, not as a screenshot or a summary.
rule: canvas_update with a card shape: kind browser and the tabId
prompt: Open https://example.test/status in a browser tab and put that tab on the canvas next to this turn.
